name: GIPHY
tagline: Industry-standard GIF search, trending, and stickers API for apps
description: GIPHY provides a REST API for searching, browsing trending content, and retrieving GIFs and stickers. Developers use an API key with self-serve signup; free and paid tiers are available for production apps.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter; self-serve signup at developers.giphy.com dashboard

use_cases: search GIFs by keyword for chat or messaging features
fetch trending GIFs for a discovery feed
get a random GIF for a reaction or placeholder
translate text into a relevant GIF
